business_problem: IBM’s CIO organization needed to modernize the w3 intranet so employees could search for people, tools and IT support more easily while the platform itself moved off older virtualized infrastructure onto a more maintainable cloud-native foundation.
solution_summary: The IBM CIO organization rebuilt the w3 intranet by modernizing infrastructure, applications and AI-assisted user experiences at the same time. First, the team migrated from legacy infrastructure to a CIO Hybrid Cloud container platform and standardized deployment through a CI/CD model, which improved release rigor and global routing performance. It then refactored the user experience around GraphQL, ReactJS and the IBM Carbon Design System so search, people, news, apps and IT support could live inside one coherent interface. On top of that new foundation, IBM watsonx.ai, IBM watsonx Assistant and IBM Granite models were introduced to power more intelligent search and self-service experiences. The result is a personalized intranet that connects multiple internal services while using AI to surface the right content and support options inside a single, modern digital workplace.
